unmapped_concepts.fact:person.liquid_financial_assets: policyengine-us splits this stock across three person inputs, which the populace-us donor H5 also carries as person columns. Their engine documentation: bank_account_assets ('Value of checking, savings, and money market accounts. Imputed from SIPP TVAL_BANK.'), stock_assets ('Value of stocks and mutual funds. Imputed from SIPP TVAL_STMF.') and bond_assets ('Value of bonds and government securities. Imputed from SIPP TVAL_BOND.'). All three uprate with CPI-U (gov.bls.cpi.cpi_u), the concept's consumer-price index family. The documentation names no term deposits. In the donor (microcosm.build.us_runtime.scf_wealth and sipp_financial_assets), each household takes its whole three-column vector from either the SCF or the SIPP, about half each, and the vector sits on the member with the lowest CPS line number (the householder is line 1), with every other member at zero. SCF-sourced households carry a draw of an SCF family-unit total, whose bank column comes from SCF liq (checking, savings, money-market and call accounts) and so leaves out term deposits. SIPP-sourced households carry a draw from a model trained on individual SIPP holdings (December person records, each with that person's own TVAL_BANK, TVAL_STMF and TVAL_BOND), whose bank leaf includes certificates of deposit: its quality screen reads the SIPP CD value allocation flags (AJSCDVAL, AJOCDVAL, AOCDVAL). Neither half holds each owner's share. spm_unit_assets (SPM unit; read by the federal CCDF asset test is_ccdf_asset_eligible, the Massachusetts, Indiana, Iowa and Texas child-care asset tests ma_ccfa_asset_eligible, in_ccdf_asset_eligible, ia_cca_asset_eligible and tx_ccs_asset_eligible, and Illinois's HBI resource test il_hbi_resource_eligible) is a unit stock the engine defines only by its label 'SPM unit assets', so feeding it would be a modelling choice. No transform here splits one amount across three inputs: a share pair splits it in two, and a fraction is never decoded. So decode cannot recover the concept from these inputs, and encoding it waits for a reviewed three-way split.
